name: Unregistered remote event handler
description: Flags a remote Event Type.OnFoo(...) handler that neither this script nor any parent it Extends ever RegisterForRemoteEvent's, so the engine will not call it. Fallout 4 / Starfield only.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a remote event handler written as `Event Type.OnFoo(...)` (the Fallout 4 / Starfield qualified form) when neither this script nor any parent it `Extends` calls `RegisterForRemoteEvent` for that event leaf. Those handlers do not fire unless something registers them; a handler with no registration in its ancestry is dead code. Matches `RegisterForRemoteEvent` by function name alone (case-insensitively), unqualified or through any receiver. When the call's event-name argument is a string literal, only that event leaf is treated as registered (`"OnCellAttach"` covers `Event ObjectReference.OnCellAttach`); a non-literal argument is treated as covering every remote handler so a computed name is not a false positive. `UnregisterForRemoteEvent` is not a registration. Each script's registrations are stored when the project indexes it, and the check walks the `Extends` chain so a parent that registers covers a child's remote handler. Incomplete ancestry resolution (a missing parent script) is left unflagged rather than guessed at. Related: `event-registration-lifecycle` pairs Register*/Unregister* in general. Scoped to Fallout 4 and Starfield via the rule's `games` field; Skyrim classic has no remote events.
